title: AMD’s dual-GPU Radeon HD 6990 launched 15 years ago — power, heat, and noise monster was crowned the fastest graphics card in the world | Tom's Hardware
summary: The AMD Radeon HD 6990 graphics card, released 15 years ago, was a high-performance dual-GPU card that pushed silicon to its limits, resulting in issues with heat, noise, and power consumption. Despite these drawbacks, it was praised for its impressive specs and performance, especially when compared to its contemporaries like the Nvidia GeForce GTX 590.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the reported issues with heat, noise, and power consumption, despite its high-performance specs.
